verwaltung.hinweis: Each AI route calls exactly one model and never falls back to another one on error. Keys live only in the server environment (.env); only the variable name is shown here. The test sends a fixed sentence, never user text.

formular.name: Name
formular.zusatz: Extra parameters (JSON, added to the request body as is)
formular.zusatzHinweis: model, messages and stream are always set by the server.
formular.zusatzKeinJson: Extra parameters are not a valid JSON object.
formular.hinweisNeu: A local route needs a key variable KI_WEG_LOKAL…_KEY, a cloud route a different one. Type and variables cannot be changed after creation.
formular.hinweisFest: Type, key and endpoint variable are fixed. For a different key, switch the route off and create a new one.
